# The product team's contract for this repository (product-team plugin, reference/stack-contract.md).
name: Team Console
repo: geeera/team-console
mode: new
stack: >
  Nx monorepo — Angular 22 PWA (apps/console, FSD libs), Cloudflare Workers with Hono (apps/api, apps/hooks),
  D1, Cloudflare Access, Playwright. See docs/decisions/0001-stack-and-architecture.md.
decisions_dir: docs/decisions

# Node 22 (.nvmrc) and npm. `e2e` and `storybook` are added by #14 and #13; until then they exit 0
# so the contract stays runnable, but print an explicit SKIPPED line so the output cannot be read
# as a passing run. The PRs for #14 / #13 must replace them with the real commands.
commands:
  install: npm ci
  lint: npx nx run-many -t lint
  test: npx nx run-many -t test
  build: npx nx run-many -t build
  e2e: 'echo "SKIPPED: no e2e tests ran — apps/console-e2e arrives with #14; this is NOT a pass"'
  storybook: npx nx build-storybook console-shared-ui

environments:
  dev:
    url: ''
  stage:
    url: 'https://team-console-stage.geeera.workers.dev'
  production:
    url: ''

design:
  tokens:
    - libs/console/shared/ui/src/tokens/tokens.css
  storybook_url: 'https://team-console-storybook.pages.dev'

sprint:
  length_days: 14
  freeze_days: 2

caps: {}

review:
  qa: always                 # QA on every PR (owner decision 2026-09-30)
  reviewer: code             # code review only when the PR changes a path below
  code_paths: ["apps/**", "libs/**", "tools/**"]
  max_rework_rounds: 1       # guidance: after one rework round only blockers go back; the rest become follow-ups

team:
  plugin_ref: stable
  reviewer_logins: ['team-console-review[bot]']
  run_log_issue: 22

owner:
  language: ru
  timezone: Europe/Kyiv
